native.pixel_policy: Apply the selected graph admission after decoder output and before CUDA upload.
native.gray: CUDA pinned BGR2GRAY from the same color-decoded raster; not codec-direct grayscale.

grayscale_reader_extension.frame_policy: Decode color and requested gray from the same immutable byte snapshot; require matching uint8 dimensions/orientation before CUDA upload; no resizing.
grayscale_reader_extension.calibrated_policy: Reader control is unavailable; grayscale continues deriving from corrected RGB.
grayscale_reader_extension.cache_policy: Mode binds preparation and archived facts; retain guarded RGB across a same-source mode change and publish the new gray atomically after source/code audits.

limits: Historical input boundary uses readimage(mode=rgb). Reader versions3.0/3.1 additionally select readimage(mode=gray) on24 uncalibrated working identities.
Encoded cap is not decoder memory or process RSS proof.
Exact supported fixture comparisons do not cover every codec variant.
Owned decoded-array cap is not a bound on encoded bytes, codec-internal scratch or process RSS.
Native/RGBA/normalize and non-raster public reader modes, original SMPTS and scientific validation remain separate gates.
native_extensions: Unicode paths load via Python byte snapshots; pinned OpenCV4.11 Windows path imread rejects the selected Unicode filename. Codec pixels match the identical ASCII-path input; path-outcome parity is not claimed.
